fields.Name: T188 - Legislative Body Issues Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Legislative Body's full record form exposes a related Legislative Issues section that renders related rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Legislative Bodies' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Legislative Bodies', then click the exact 'Legislative Bodies' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Open a legislative body record's full form (click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'). Scroll down to the form's related-records sections and open the 'Legislative Issues' related section. Verify it shows related rows OR a valid empty-state (the related section being present and rendering is success). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Legislative Body full record form is open showing body detail fields
The related 'Legislative Issues' section is present and rendering - showing issue rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
